name: files_getfilep

ownership.argument: Resolve and retain a file from an explicit filelist, independent caller task group. Caller must check 0<=fd<8*filelist.u8_rows first. Release with fs_putfilep.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery for fd-independent QJS event-loop notification, 2026-10-30; native async wake EBADF captured at C3F5758.

notes: Exact .155 private ABI for owner-loop pipe lookup. TCB+100 TLS -> taskinfo -> UV key at 200BD444 -> uvstate+664 default loop. Matched TCB+8 group; group+96 filelist. Entry bytes: 80 b5 4b 42 03 f0 07 03 01 f0 07 02. No fixed PID or caller-group fd assumption.
